Subject: Redwood MSA redlines — insurance section

Hi Ben,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA. Attached are Stratos' redlines (see 'Stratos_MSA_redlines_20250720.pdf'). The main items to flag:
- We need language confirming Redwood will name Stratos as additional insured under general liability and technology E&O for claims arising out of Redwood's services.
- Minimum limits requested are $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate for general liability and $5M for E&O.
- Evidence: We generally need a COI and proof of primary, non-contributory wording. We can accept a broker-attested PDF provided via email.

Can you review and confirm whether Redwood can provide these endorsements or alternative mitigations (e.g., contractual caps, carve-outs)? We're under a procurement deadline this Friday.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stratos Analytics

Subject: Re: Redwood MSA redlines — insurance section

Anita — thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. I appreciate the timeline heads-up.

Quick replies:
1) Additional insured: We typically provide additional insured on general liability for customers hosting our service, but E&O endorsement is less common. I'm looping in Lauren from Legal to confirm whether we can add Stratos as additional insured on E&O or whether a separate contractual representation + COI will be our standard approach.
2) Limits: Our standard limits today are 1M/2M GL and 2M E&O; I will confirm whether we have flexibility to increase for this deal and what that would mean for pricing.
3) COI: We can produce a COI and can ask our broker for primary/ non-contributory endorsement where allowed by our carrier. If Stratos requires broker-to-broker confirmation, please share the broker contact.

I'll follow up after I hear back from Legal and from our insurance broker team. If there are must-have contractual language lines for Stratos' legal team, paste them here and we'll evaluate.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-07-20T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA redlines — insurance section

Ben / Karthik / Anita — looping in with Legal's assessment. Summary of positions and options below.

Assessment:
- Additional insured on General Liability (GL): acceptable. We can add Stratos as additional insured for liabilities arising from Redwood's operations and services. Standard endorsement available.
- Additional insured on E&O / Technology Professional Liability: carriers typically do not endorse E&O policies to add customer as additional insured; instead we can provide a contractual representation and full defense/ indemnity language tailored to limited circumstances.
- Limits: increasing GL/E&O to the requested levels (2M/4M GL and 5M E&O) may require underwriting review and premium adjustments — not guaranteed.

Recommended next steps (to keep procurement moving):
1) Redwood provides an updated draft MSA with: (a) GL additional insured endorsement language, (b) representation re: E&O (no additional insured) and proposal to provide proof of coverage and COI with primary/non-contributory where our carrier permits.
2) Redwood to deliver current COI and summary of limits within 48 hours. We will ask broker if they can issue the required endorsements; if not, offer alternative mitigations (higher cap, carve-out, or escrow for high-risk data handling).
3) If Stratos insists on 5M E&O and our broker declines, we escalate with underwriting — Karthik, please flag to Finance/Insurance and get ETA from broker.

I attach a short checklist we typically send to prospective customers to speed evidence collection.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_insurance_checklist.pdf (pdf)
